How to make a Discord server QR code

The code holds your server's invite link.

  1. In Discord, open your server and use the invite option to create an invite link.
  2. In the invite settings, choose how long the link lasts and how many uses it allows.
  3. Copy the link and paste it into the field above.
  4. Style the code and download the PNG or SVG.
  5. Test the code with an account that has not joined the server.

Invite links can expire, and that breaks your QR code

A Discord invite may expire after a set time or a number of uses. If it does, the QR code will lead to an invalid invite. For printed codes, create an invite that does not expire and has no use limit, then use that link.

Also consider who you are letting in. An open, permanent invite can be shared widely, so set up moderation and verification on your server first.

Tips for Discord QR codes

A few habits keep your community safe and your code working.

  • Use a non-expiring invite for anything printed.
  • Set verification levels and rules before you invite the public.
  • Tell people what they are joining, for example "Scan to join our study group".
  • Replace the invite if it is abused. Delete the old invite and print a new code.
